offline_1_F1_counterfactual.definitions:
T30 #1 — F1 (+F1b) counterfactual on the pre-T30 E3 server records (T28 Phase 3 E3a/E3b).

Inputs restored with benchmark.trajopt.experiments.fixed_input_ablation (T24 tool, working tree = T30):
  settings        : T.parse_server_log(<cond>_rec/serve_safe_<port>.log) + run manifest (safe_phase approach, manipulators left)
  robot model     : T.build_robot (links gripper, spacing 0.4, max 32, capsule_radius_scale 0.05) — 122 constraint spheres
  field           : T.build_field(chunk npz) — coarse + fine + target-free (esdf_free_*) layers as recorded
  contact policy  : T.contact_policy (ClearancePolicy x phase approach, manipulators left, exclude_authorized) — margin + mask
  q_now           : local planning row paired to that server chunk (T28 p3/<COND>_analysis.json 'server_chunk', exact actions match)
  finger joints   : FingerJointMap.path(measured = summary.finger_joints.opening_norm, commanded = reference_chunk cols 7/15,
                    horizon 8, default = model param vector) — same call as SafePolicy._apply_finger_state (T29)
Rules:
  new  : T.make_scene(...) as is  -> SceneSnapshot.target_free_exempt = None = target_free_mask (T30 F1)
  old  : dataclasses.replace(new_scene, target_free_exempt=np.zeros(S, bool))  (pre-T30 rule, as the tests do)
Trajectories: reference = reference_chunk[:, :8] (TO initial iterate), refined = recorded refined_chunk[:, :8] (TO output).
Per trajectory x rule: linearizer.worst_row (value + row identity incl. tier) and the full (8, S) esdf_clearance.
  violated            : worst clearance < 0 (same sign test as the recorded to.metrics.clearance_m < 0 / initial_violation_m > 0)
  target-margin row   : a row whose margin is the manipulated-object margin, recomputed here with the linearizer's own test
                        (|d_eff - d_object| <= voxel, d_object = KD-tree distance to recorded target_points, row in the
                        manipulated_link_margin set with margin != esdf_margin). Under the new rule exempt rows are removed first.
                        The recorded label layer is not in the npz, so this stands in for the recorded obstacle == 'target'.
  target_free.target  : worst row with tier == 'target_free' and target-margin row True
  GT object           : worst row query sphere centre (base) -> MuJoCo world (base pose from the paired planning row qpos) ->
                        nearest non-robot collision geom by mj_geomDistance from a 0.1 mm probe (T28 P1-2 helper)
Fidelity (old rule, refined): reconstructed worst_row clearance vs recorded to.metrics.clearance_m, and the same (step, query) row.
Attached chunks (esdf_stats.n_attached_points > 0) are skipped (held-object query points are not recorded).
usage: f1_counterfactual.py COND   (COND = E3a | E3b)
offline_1_F1_counterfactual.note_label: recorded obstacle label ('target') comes from the server label layer, not in the npz; offline 'target' = row carrying the manipulated-object margin (linearizer test). label_check_refined_old_vs_recorded compares the two on recorded residual violations.
offline_1_F1_counterfactual.note_recorded_counts: recorded_* counts are over all 450 chunks incl. attached; old/new counts are over evaluated (non-attached) chunks

offline_3_F4_replay.definitions:
T30 #3 — F4 (settled = measured opening standing still, settle_epsilon) replayed with the working-tree GraspLatch.

(a) T14 / T16 / T17 (ep1807, live_test 20260928): T22 verifier replay reused as is — outputs/verify/T22/replay_t22.py
    `replay(run, source)` (feedback reconstructed from local control rows; GraspLatch(LatchConfig(), evidence=True);
    last gate = real AG3S.attach on a stub). source 'apple' (GT apple centroid) and 'server_prev' (previous chunk's server
    target centroid), as T22.
(b) Empty-hand MuJoCo sweep: T22 #4e (outputs/verify/T22/empty_sweep_t22.py) logic copied here (that script imports
    scenarios_t22, which rewrites a T22 file on import) — same q0 (T17 planning seq 2), 33 mj_step per control step,
    close target {0.0, 0.3, 0.57} x start step 0..7, reach forced 0.042 m, run_seq identical to scenarios_t22.run_seq.
(c) T28 E3a/E3b (12 runs): per run, server chunks in order (T28 p3/<COND>_analysis.json pairing). Signal =
    grasp_signal_from_feedback(recorded summary.exec_feedback, hand 0, cfg.gripper_closed_below) — the feedback the server
    actually received. reach = parent_reach(load_rby1(), q20 of the paired planning row, 'ee_finger_l1', centroid) with
    centroid = previous chunk's recorded manipulated centroid (base) ['server_prev'] or GT apple (base) ['apple'];
    manipulated_id/state = previous chunk's recorded manipulated. Last gate = AG3S.attach stub (as T22). After each request
    latch.update(label='manipulated', score=1, runner_up=0) (as T22).
The T22 AG3S.attach stub gains `admissibility_of` (AG3S.attach calls it since T26; see _make_ag3s).
Reported: attach / detach request t_step, with the old rule (recorded summary.grasp.attach) alongside for (c).

definitions.replay:
T30 #2 — F3 (association + pre-grasp anchor) replayed on recorded grounding inputs: E3a/E3b (T28 Phase 3, 12 runs) + T14 + T17.

Input per chunk: server record chunk_k.npz (attention_cloud, attention_values, attention_raw, support_mask, t_step),
paired with the local planning row (E3: T28 p3/<COND>_analysis.json 'server_chunk'; T14/T17: seq k+1, T14.audit §1).
Call (working tree = T30):
  confirm = TargetConfirm(cfg.clustering, max_opening=0.07146, overlap_distance=0.005)            # 'new' (T30 defaults:
            manipulated_extent_ratio 2.5, manipulated_anchor_coverage 0.9)
  confirm = TargetConfirm(..., extent_ratio=None, anchor_coverage=None)                             # 'old' (T26 behaviour) — the
            fidelity check: its manipulated id/state/centroid must reproduce the server record (E3 only)
  ground_target(AttentionPointCloud(...), cfg.clustering, seed_percentile, seed_threshold, exclude_mask=support_mask,
                min_radius, timestamp=t_step, confirm=confirm)
Freeze: E3 -> confirm.freeze(summary.exclusion.grasp_active) of that chunk (the recorded latch; T30b note);
        T14/T17 (no latch record) -> freeze from the first chunk whose policy chunk (actions_reference rows 0..7, col 7) < 0.5
        to the end (T28 off_0ab variant B).
Exclusion gate + ball: pipeline._exclusion_gate (usable, admissible, narrowest <= 71.46 mm, destination overlap < fraction) and
pipeline._target_ball: centre = mean(manipulated.points), radius = quantile(|p - c|, esdf.target_ball_quantile) +
target_ball_pad_voxels x 5 mm; z_min not applied (support planes are not in the record).
GT apple: MuJoCo body 'apple' pos from the planning row object_poses, brought into the robot base frame with the base pose of
that row's qpos. apple radius R_APPLE = 34 mm (T30b / lead definition).
  centre_inside = |c_ball - apple| <= r_ball ;  whole_inside = |c_ball - apple| + 34 mm <= r_ball ;  no ball -> neither.
Occupancy behind an uncovered apple (E3 only, whole_inside False): voxels of the RECORDED fine layer (esdf_distance, with the apple,
5 mm) with distance <= 0 whose centre is within 34 + 15 mm of the GT apple centre, split into inside / outside the replayed ball.
Voxels outside the ball are the ones the target-free layer would still carry (the target-free layer = the fine layer with the
ball's seeds excluded). Validation of that reading on the ORIGINAL records: recorded target-free layer (esdf_free_distance)
occupied voxels within apple+15 mm vs recorded-fine occupied voxels within apple+15 mm and outside the RECORDED ball.
Groups (coordinator note): pre_grasp_nonfrozen (main), frozen (latch closing/held -> grasp_active), after_switch (any chunk after the
first T26 'switch' decision in that run).
usage: f3_replay.py
definitions.groups:
Summarise off2/f3_replay.json. Groups (coordinator note, T30):
  pre_grasp_nonfrozen : E3 -> T28 analysis phase 'pre_grasp' and not frozen; T14/T17 -> before the first planning row with GT apple
                        dz >= 50 mm (and before the freeze chunk), not frozen
  frozen              : frozen (E3: recorded exclusion.grasp_active; T14/T17: from the grasp-attempt chunk)
  after_switch        : any chunk (either of the above) after the first T26 'switch' decision of that run, per rule
Counts per rule (new = T30 defaults, old = T26 behaviour, E3 only). 'manip_not_apple' = manipulated centroid's nearest object
centre != apple (or no manipulated).
definitions.occupancy:
T30 #2 occupancy near the GT apple, table excluded (supersedes the occupancy numbers inside f3_replay.json, which include table voxels
under the apple). For every E3 chunk in f3_replay.json:
  region  = voxel centres within 34 + 15 mm of the GT apple centre AND world z > apple z - 34 mm + 5 mm (above the table top + 1 voxel;
            the apple rests on the table in pre-grasp chunks)
  occupied = recorded layer value d <= 0
  (a) tf_recorded           : recorded target-free layer (esdf_free_distance; built with the RECORDED (pre-T30) ball) occupied in region
  (b) fine_out_old_ball     : recorded fine layer occupied in region, outside the replayed OLD-rule ball (compare with (a))
  (c) fine_out_new_ball     : recorded fine layer occupied in region, outside the replayed NEW-rule (T30) ball
  (d) fine_in_region        : recorded fine layer occupied in region
World z of a base-frame voxel: base pose from the paired planning row qpos (T28 P1-2 helper).

                    nearest GT object by mj_geomDistance (0.1 mm probe, P1-2 helper); inside_apple = signed distance to apple < 0
  refined-ref     : max over arm joints (16D 0-6, 8-14), executed rows 0-7 of |actions - actions_reference| (deg), local

                    measured opening qpos[27]/0.045 over the chunk's control rows (min / last)

baseline_5_self_filter_leak.definitions:
T30 #5 — self-filter leak per robot body on the regression-baseline record run_16d_ep1800 (15 frames x zed_left / wrist_cam_l /
wrist_cam_r), working tree (T30b cover incl. base), GT segmentation. Method = T28 off_0e / T29 (P1-3b): every valid depth pixel
back-projected, filter_robot_points(robot = grounding_report.build_robot_model(scene), q, PointCloudConfig(self_filter_inflation=X)),
finger joints from the scene (set_finger_joints_from_scene). Scene / pose via policy_record.load_run / replay_scene / pose_scene
(the esdf_rollout path). 'leak' = robot-body pixels that pass the filter; 'other_pass' = non-robot, non-apple pixels kept;
also non-robot pixels REMOVED by the filter per body (e.g. crate). usage: base_leak.py INFLATION OUT.jsonl
